about: The graduale of the formulary “Transfiguration of Our Lord” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: You surpass the sons of men in beauty. Grace has been poured out on Your lips. My heart has poured out a noble word. I myself recite my compositions to the King.

ex.w001: Speciósus is a positive adjective meaning beautiful. Præ supplies the comparison with the sons of men. The address leaves “You are” unexpressed.
ex.w012: The heart is pictured as pouring out words. The image presents the speaker’s inward thought becoming an utterance.
ex.w019: Ópera is plural: the speaker’s works or compositions. In this declaration to the King, it names what the speaker recites.
